title: The winner of a bid can brick the auction house
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  Whenever an auction is over, `_settleAuction()` is called. We have 2 main flows there - when no one has bid for the auction and when there is a bidder for the auction. We will focus on the latter. One of the lines we have for that flow is this one:  ```solidity apiologyToken.safeTransferFrom(address(this), _auction.bidder, _auction.apdaoId); ```  It uses `safeTransferFrom()` to transfer the NFT from the contract to the bidder.
